review.notes: The sole live blocking finding at revision 22 is the Playwright trace-lifecycle conflict. The retry candidate directly and narrowly remedies that conflict by replacing manual context tracing with runner-managed tracing and requires the focused browser gate, current-source gates, and independent review. It preserves the approved scope and introduces no unsafe product or deployment action. Under an operator-attested private-source policy, the revised audit is sufficient because it binds the observed manager proposal to snapshot.proposal and decision-packet candidates, while negative tests demonstrate rejection of independent mismatches. Limitations: This review used only the supplied sanitized files and did not access or independently hash the retained private raw bytes. Source authenticity is sufficient only under the stated operator-attested private-source policy; it is not independently reproducible without the retained private files. The evidence does not cryptographically prove remote provider execution or model identity. The runtime shadow outcome abstained and selected no candidate; acceptableSelections is an independent review determination, not a claim that runtime selected it. The candidate is provisionally effective as a recovery action; successful trace production remains to be demonstrated by the required retry validations.
